title: Privacy and terms
body:
The short version

  • No account. You can use the whole guide without telling us who you are.
  • What you save stays with you. Saved places and searches are kept in your browser, not sent to us.
  • Nothing sold, no ads. We don’t sell anything about you, and there are no ads.
  • A person checks every change. What you send is read by someone before it goes up.
  • An AI reads, it doesn’t answer. It helps read some questions and messages. Answers always come from the guide’s own listings.

What you tell us

  • Searches. We count searches that found nothing, by their words, so we know what to add. We don’t keep who searched. When our own search can’t make sense of a question, its words go to OpenAI, which says which of the guide’s filters it means. Nothing else about you is sent. Please don’t type personal details into the search box.
  • A change or a new place. It goes to our team to check. Your name and email are optional; we use them only if we need to ask you about it, and they’re never shown on the site. If you paste a message or add a photo, OpenAI reads it to find the times, items or details in it, and you see what it found before you send. Photos are kept with your suggestion.
  • Feedback. Your message, and your email if you’d like a reply.
  • Email updates. Your email and what you asked to hear about. Every email has a link to stop them.

What stays on your device

Your saved places and searches, the location you set, and things you’ve closed are kept by your browser, not sent to us. Clearing your browser’s data removes them.

A thumbs-up is tied to a random code your browser makes up, not to you.

Your location

Only if you allow it. It’s used to show distances and what’s near you, and we don’t store it. The map is Google’s, so Google sees the map requests your device makes.

You can turn it off any time in your browser or phone settings.

How we see the site is working

  • Vercel Analytics counts visits and pages, without cookies.
  • PostHog shows how the site is used: pages opened and buttons tapped, and recordings of some visits, with anything typed hidden.
  • Sentry reports errors so we can fix them.

None of it is used for ads.

Who else is involved

  • Vercel hosts the site.
  • Supabase stores the listings and what people send.
  • Google draws the maps and gives the public details of places, like hours.
  • OpenAI reads some questions, messages and photos, as above.
  • Cloudflare Turnstile checks that a person, not a bot, is sending something.
  • Upstash limits how often one connection can send, by its IP address, to stop abuse.
  • Resend sends our emails.

Each has its own privacy policy.

How long we keep it

Suggestions stay as each listing’s history. Names and emails on them are deleted when you ask. Email sign-ups last until you unsubscribe. Search counts are kept with nothing about who searched.

Asking us

To see, correct or delete anything you’ve sent, or if something about you is on the site that shouldn’t be, email person2@example.test.

Terms of use

  • Check what matters. Hours, times, kashrus and medical details change. Every fact says when it was last checked; confirm anything important with the place itself.
  • Not an endorsement. Being listed doesn’t mean we recommend, certify or speak for a place.
  • Not for emergencies. In an emergency, call 911.
  • Use it kindly. Don’t use the guide to harass, track or harm anyone, or copy it in bulk with automated tools.
  • What you send. Send only what’s yours to share and true as far as you know. We may edit or turn down anything, and what we publish becomes part of the guide.
  • Other sites. Links to maps, websites and WhatsApp groups go to services we don’t run.
  • As is. The guide is run by volunteers and offered as it is. As far as the law allows, we aren’t responsible for what comes of relying on it.

If this page changes, the date at the top changes with it.
